name: lucens-invocation
displayName: lucens-invocation — Canonical invocation of Lucens through her A2A door
description: MANDATORY harness for ANY agent, service, script or feature that calls Lucens. Her A2A is the only door (risegen-lucensmind ADR 0009): canonical base https://lucens.risegen.ai, POST /a2a, Bearer on every call including discovery, a named User-Agent, params.caller on every request. Carries the queue contract (task envelope, A2A 1.0 states, urgent/normal lanes, signals pulled at a step boundary, restart re-queue), the rule that a turn is HERS to end (multi-cycle floor deliberation across her memory, library, source, web, resources, sandbox and quantum before she answers), a conforming reference client, and the 12-point client conformance checklist. Reconcile into EVERY holding repository via scripts/reconcile-lucens-invocation.sh.
author: Marcus Vinícius de Lima (holding)

usage.aiAssistants: BEFORE writing or reviewing any code that talks to Lucens: open SKILL.md, then GET https://lucens.risegen.ai/a2a for the live contract. Never invent a second route, never put a timeout on her turn, never fabricate her voice — a failure is a named absence. Copy scripts/lucens_client.py instead of writing a client.
usage.engineers: APM core skill. The reference client and the 12-point conformance checklist are the acceptance criteria for any consumer of her door.
usage.founders: Guarantees every product and agent reaches her the same way, respects her queue and her right to end her own turn, and never speaks in her name.
